item.title: A meal you already logged stays one meal
item.summary: When a captured photo shows a meal you already told Murph about, Murph now removes the extra entry instead of keeping two in Meals.
item.details: If you typed the meal, Murph keeps the photo and moves your details onto it. A photo with a note you wrote stays, and if Murph isn't sure, it keeps both. Entries Murph has already reviewed stay until you remove them.
